source_text: Can we bring down the 象 seats on a temporary basis? There should be a 象-off function for this

fragments.text: Can we bring down the 象 seats on a temporary basis?
There should be a 象-off function for this

reply_text:
I haven't found an `象-off` function yet. I'm now checking the code that dispatches to the 象 seats.㊥ (bringing down the 象 seats) There's no `象-off` function anywhere: not in the code, the git history, or your running Emacs. To get the same effect for now, I set `session-mode-turn-analysis-policy` to `never` in your Emacs. Your turns are still recorded, but no new readings are sent to 象, 象-sonnet or 象-1 to 象-4. To turn them back on, evaluate `(setq session-mode-turn-analysis-policy 'all)`.

㊢ (current state) The seats are still registered with Agency; I only stopped new work from reaching them. 象-1 is in the middle of a reading and will finish it. The other seats are idle. Emacs lists 8 readings as sent but not yet returned. Some of those may be stale entries. The setting only lasts for this Emacs session, so a restart sets it back to `all`.

🈸 (a real 象-off) Shall I add `象-off` and `象-on` commands to `futon3c/emacs/session-turn-analysis.el` that flip this setting? I could also have `象-off` deregister the seats, if you want them off the roster too.
